$comment: Type-checking for the test tree (#542). Tests are not BUILT — `tsc -p tsconfig.json` still compiles only src/ into dist/, so neither the build's output nor its speed changes. What this adds is a guard: a test file that drifts from the types it exercises now fails `npm run check:types` instead of silently going stale. `src` is included alongside `__tests__` so the tests type-check against the real signatures, not a stray copy.
